intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Mumbai, but they sit in completely different admission pools. This page compares official IIT Bombay fees, recorded placements and NIRF 2025 Engineering ranks, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

IIT Bombay vs KJ Somaiya College of Engineering starts with the entrance test. IIT Bombay admits through JEE Advanced and is ranked 3 in NIRF 2025 Engineering. KJ Somaiya admits through MHT-CET and has only an older 2021 NIRF Engineering rank of 196 here.

sections.heading: IIT Bombay vs KJ Somaiya College of Engineering for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIT Bombay if you can clear JEE Advanced and want the NIRF 2025 Engineering rank 3 campus, plus the only 2020 or later placement record on this page.

Choose KJ Somaiya if you are in the MHT-CET pool and want a Mumbai private engineering college. This page does not have a 2020 or later flagship placement row for Somaiya, and its latest NIRF Engineering rank here is from 2021.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: IIT Bombay's official fee page for 2025 UG new entrants lists statutory tuition of ₹1,00,000 per semester, or ₹2,00,000 a year, for Indian nationals in the General, EWS and OBC-NCL categories. SC, ST and PwD students are exempted from that tuition.

The same official page lists first-semester academic fees of ₹1,28,250 for those full-tuition students, including one-time charges and deposits, plus hostel fees of ₹19,400 and a separate mess advance. Our records already show tuition of ₹2 lakh a year, which matches the official annual tuition. Hostel and one-time rows in the detailed table are not the programme tuition.

KJ Somaiya's recorded tuition on this page is ₹2.48 lakh a year, with smaller development, exam, library and deposit rows beside it. Those smaller rows are not the flagship tuition. Confirm Somaiya's official circular for your quota.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IIT Bombay's recorded 2024 figures on this page are an average package of ₹24 lakh and a highest package of ₹367 lakh. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise. The highest figure is an extreme offer and should be read with the official placement report, not as a typical package.

KJ Somaiya's latest recorded placement year here is 2016, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹13 lakh. Because that year is older than 2020, this page does not treat it as a current flagship result.
Ask Somaiya for its latest official placement report. Do not compare a 2016 row with IIT Bombay's 2024 figures as if they described the same year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: IIT Bombay admits B.Tech students through JEE Advanced, after JEE Main, via JoSAA counselling. A qualifying Class 12 performance is also required, as set out in the JEE Advanced brochure.

KJ Somaiya College of Engineering lists Maharashtra CET, or MHT-CET, on this page. State and institute-level rules for minority or management seats can also apply. A MHT-CET rank is not a route into IIT Bombay.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Mumbai, Maharashtra, but they are not neighbours. IIT Bombay is at Powai. KJ Somaiya's engineering campus is at Vidyavihar.
If you already plan to stay in Mumbai, the choice is about the entrance test and the official standing of the institute, not about leaving the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you have a JEE Advanced rank, IIT Bombay is the stronger fit on every official measure this page can show: NIRF 2025 Engineering rank 3, official ₹2 lakh annual tuition, and a 2024 placement record.

If you are in the MHT-CET pool, KJ Somaiya is the relevant campus here. Ask the college for a current placement report and fee circular, because this page only holds a 2016 placement row and a 2021 NIRF rank.
Do not use IIT Bombay's hostel or one-time rows, or Somaiya's smaller fee heads, as the programme tuition.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, IIT Bombay or KJ Somaiya College of Engineering?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay is ranked 3 in NIRF 2025 Engineering and admits through JEE Advanced. KJ Somaiya admits through MHT-CET and has only a 2021 NIRF Engineering rank of 196 here. They are not interchangeable. IIT Bombay also has the only 2020 or later placement record on this page, from 2024.

faqs.question: What are the official B.Tech fees for IIT Bombay vs KJ Somaiya?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay's official 2025 tuition is ₹1,00,000 per semester, or ₹2,00,000 a year, for Indian General, EWS and OBC-NCL students, with a tuition waiver for SC, ST and PwD students. First-semester academic fees are ₹1,28,250 on the official new-entrants page. Somaiya's recorded tuition is ₹2.48 lakh a year; confirm its official circular.

faqs.question: Does KJ Somaiya accept JEE Advanced?
faqs.answer: KJ Somaiya lists Maharashtra CET, or MHT-CET, on this page. IIT Bombay requires JEE Advanced. A MHT-CET rank is not enough for IIT Bombay.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for IIT Bombay and KJ Somaiya?
faqs.answer: IIT Bombay's recorded 2024 average is ₹24 lakh and the highest is ₹367 lakh, which is an extreme offer and should be read with the official report. Somaiya's latest recorded year here is 2016, which this page does not treat as a current flagship result.

faqs.question: Are IIT Bombay and KJ Somaiya in the same part of Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Both are in Mumbai, but on different campuses. IIT Bombay is at Powai. KJ Somaiya's engineering campus is at Vidyavihar.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Confirm the current JEE Advanced and MHT-CET brochures, IIT Bombay's official fee page and Somaiya's fee circular and placement report before you apply or pay.
